title: Surgical KV-lease revocation and retry coordinator for tenant surge-induced 5xx spikes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Several customers escalated production incidents where tenant surge patterns caused sudden KV-cache lease revocations on serving nodes, resulting in streaming timeouts and 5xx responses followed by amplified client retries. Root cause appears to be concurrent lease compaction during reshards plus a race where inflight request KV lookups return invalidated state, causing the runtime to take slowfallback paths and sometimes crash connection handlers. This ticket implements a surgical hotpatch plus a longer-lived coordinator to: (1) gracefully revoke KV leases across a tenant's shard without evicting active prefixes; (2) insert a per-tenant short-term admission controller that applies gentle backpressure and token smoothing to stop retry storms; (3) introduce a retry-coordinator that deduplicates near-simultaneous identical requests for a short window to prevent amplification; (4) align SDK retry guidance and add an observability slice to measure retry amplification and prefix-miss rates. The approach targets Hosted first, with compatibility fallbacks for Dedicated and Private (config flag to disable admission controller).
acceptance_criteria: Hotpatch deployed to canary region with zero customer-visible 5xx regressions for 24h
Metric: per-tenant 5xx rate reduced by >= 80% during synthetic surge test
Metric: retry amplification ratio (client retries / successful requests) reduced to < 1.25 in canary
End-to-end latency for streaming tails not regressed by more than 10%
Runbook updated and customer-facing incident summary drafted
notes: Triage 2026-03-02: Pager rotation red team confirmed 3 customers showing identical KV-lease churn traces
Initial repro: sim-tenant-surge harness reproduced prefix miss storms (see dashboard link)
Chosen mitigation: orchestrated lease revocation + admission controller rather than full-stop eviction to avoid cold-start thundering herd
Trade-offs: short token window may slightly increase tail latency for a very small percentage of requests but prevents broad 5xx cascades
Fallback: in Dedicated/Private we will provide a toggle (runtime.flag.disable_tenant_admission) and recommend operator-side throttle policies
